A 7.7 earthquake just hit Panama #ONLYinDADE

A lot of Miami has family down there, so check on your people. Phone lines get jammed after something like this, so a text or WhatsApp may get through faster than a call.

There is a tsunami threat for parts of Panama’s coast. Nobody has confirmed deaths or damage yet, but experts expect damage near where it hit. This one is still very new and the details can change over the next few hours.

We will keep updating as official word comes in from USGS and Panama’s civil protection agency, Sinaproc.

Nobody had a phone. Nobody was posting it. You just showed your mom, put it on the fridge, and counted the days.
